# has cadastral reference

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCadastralReference`](gmeow-hasCadastralReference.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCadastralReference>

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to relate a place (parcel, lot, spatial unit) to a structured cadastral reference issued by a registry.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at a non-cadastral identifier (use the coreference slice for general external IDs).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:hasCadastralReference`](gmeow-hasCadastralReference.md) at a [`CadastralReference`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReference.md) carrying value, type, authority, and jurisdiction.
